title: Explicit Boundary Markers for Subword Vocabularies
abstract: arXiv:2608.08847v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Subword tokenizers represent many common words twice in space-using writing systems, once with a leading space and once without. The two entries have separate embeddings in models, so occurrences of one word are divided across rows that are trained independently, and the two forms need not even segment the string the same way: " together" may be a single entry while the same word without a preceding space is tokenized as "to|gether". Capitalization divides a word further, into as many as six forms. We introduce an alternative to standard whitespace conventions using an explicit word boundary marker, which prevents such duplication. Words are delimited by the boundary markers, and spaces between words are represented as pairs of such markers. translated_title: 子词词汇表中的显式词边界标记
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.08847v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：子词分词器在基于空格书写的系统中，将许多常见词表示两次：一次带有前导空格，一次不带。这两个条目在模型中具有独立的嵌入，因此一个词的出现被分割到独立训练的行中，而且两种形式甚至不需要以相同方式切分字符串：“ together”可能是一个单独条目，而同一词没有前导空格时则被分词为“to|gether”。大小写进一步将词分割，最多可达六种形式。我们引入了一种替代标准空格约定的方法，使用显式词边界标记，这避免了这种重复。词由边界标记分隔，词之间的空格表示为成对的此类标记。两个移位码同样处理标题大小写和全大写，允许一个词的内部表示在不同设置中重用。切换到这种约定减轻了重复问题。
tldr: 该论文提出用显式词边界标记替代空格分隔，以减少子词分词器中因空格和大小写导致的词条重复，并实现词表示的高效复用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using explicit word boundary markers instead of spaces to reduce token duplication caused by spaces and capitalization in subword tokenizers, enabling efficient reuse of word representations.
